France has indicated it is ready to meet India's key demands for technology transfer, local manufacturing and integration of indigenous weapons as negotiations continue for the Indian Air Force's proposed acquisition of 114 Rafale fighter jets. 

The deal could become one of the largest combat aircraft programmes in IAF history and significantly expand India's defence manufacturing capabilities under the Make in India initiative.
